source_text.body:
Triage multiple inboxes and ping only when attention is needed
A commenter runs an inbox agent that checks every email across several inboxes and only notifies them when something needs attention, cutting Gmail notifications.
·
Nov 19, 2026
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
The commenter built a small automation in their app, PocketClaw, that checks every email across all of their inboxes and decides whether anything actually needs attention. Instead of alerting on each message, it only pings them when action is needed; the person’s role was essentially to receive the filtered alert rather than monitor Gmail continuously.
How it went
It reduced interruptions enough that they turned off Gmail notifications and now get pinged about once a day or so. The post gives no deeper metrics, setup details, or failure cases beyond that.
Worth knowing
The practical bar here was low-frequency alerts: about one ping a day or so after turning off normal Gmail notifications.
Try it yourself
with
OpenClaw
Copy prompt
Check every new email across my inboxes [list accounts] and classify each one as needs attention, FYI, or ignorable. Only message me on [chat app] when something needs attention, with a one-line reason and the sender, and keep a daily digest of everything else. Never reply to, delete, or archive any email without showing me the action first and getting my approval.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/AgentsOfAI/comments/1xzlouc/what_are_the_most_useful_ai_tools_for_running_a
